{{Top|leg}}
The '''Underground Mag-Lev''' was a colloquial term that referred to an organized resistance movement to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] that existed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the newly-established [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
Established in the first few months after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the declaration of the New Order by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the Underground Mag-Lev was part of the [[Whiplash]] resistance movement. Metaphorically resembling a [[Hovertrain|mag-lev]], the network's purpose and goal was to extract [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and other political "undesirables" from Coruscant to safety in the outer regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Underground Mag-Lev is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' version of the [[Wikipedia:Underground Railroad|Underground Railroad]], a loose network of people whose aim was to help slaves to flee captivity in the American South prior to the American Civil War.
